layers.name: Contract
layers.purpose: Validate schemas, interfaces, ownership, and intended behavior

layers.name: Build
layers.purpose: Compile, resolve dependencies, and verify reproducible artifacts

layers.name: Test
layers.purpose: Exercise unit, integration, property, regression, and end-to-end behavior

layers.name: Static
layers.purpose: Detect type, lint, configuration, and code-quality risks without execution

layers.name: Security
layers.purpose: Scan secrets, dependencies, permissions, provenance, and abuse paths

layers.name: Runtime
layers.purpose: Monitor health, latency, errors, resources, and external dependencies

layers.name: Recovery
layers.purpose: Verify backup, rollback, restore, containment, and disaster procedures

layers.name: Independent challenge
layers.purpose: Use a second detector or reviewer to challenge important findings

quality_rule: Critical findings require containment; repairs require reproduction and tests; high-impact closure requires independent corroboration.
